items.title: Eddie Summers Interview, 1963-11-11
items.q: When he was playing with Rene, he'd send me in his place when he couldn't go. Uh-huh. And you got to be good friends, I guess. Always good friends.

ctx.x: Yeah. Did you copy him or did you just sort of?

Well, we used to play on the same order. I mostly played my style. Where did you see him playing at then? Well, I used to be with him for all the time.
